xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Controller of Legal Metrology, Maharashtra State, Mumbai
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Entero Healthcare Solution Limited filed an Appeal against a compounding order dt. 29.05.2025 for violating packaging rules under the Legal Metrology Act. The Controller allowed the appeal on 12.09.2025 and directed both the company and its nominated director, Mr. Prem Sethi, to pay Rs. 25,000 each as compounding fees.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The violation alleged against Entero Healthcare Solution Ltimited was for non-compliance with packaging requirements under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. Specifically, the company was found selling a pre-packaged product — “Portable Mesh Nebulizer” — without fulfilling mandatory declarations on the package, which is a breach of: Section 18(1) of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009, read with Rules 6(2) and 10(1) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, and is punishable under Section 36(1) of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The impact of the order on the company is minimal and limited to the compounding fees imposed. The appellant company, Entero Healthcare Solution Ltd., and its nominated director were directed to pay Rs. 25,000 each, totaling Rs. 50,000.
